transcript.answer: Lore's nightly `context_reindex` job was retired on 2026-09-08. ADR-019 records this in an amendment, and PR #1880 ("Retire the nightly context_reindex job and everything that only existed for it") was merged that day at 18:08 UTC. The CronJob had failed on every run for at least four nights without anyone noticing, because ingestion had already become merge-time only through the `ci-ingest` hook.
